'''Not a Decipher scan.''' This is a Players Committee copy of the printed [[Stormtrooper Cadet]] from the PC card-image server (res.starwarsccg.org). It shows the printed card face with the printed game text, but it is the PC's copy, not Decipher's scan. Decipher's own scan is [[:File:OTSD-D-stormtroopercadet-decipher-archive-wb.gif]], which the card's article and set table now show.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/OfficialTournamentSealedDeck-Dark/large/stormtroopercadet.gif stormtroopercadet.gif] (Players Committee image server). This wiki file is a flush crop of it (350×490, corner pads bleached white), uploaded 25 September 2026 under the misleading name OTSD-D-stormtroopercadet-decipher-archive.gif and moved to this name on 12 November 2026 (the old name redirects here).

'''Do not''' replace Holotable [[:File:OTSD-D-stormtroopercadet.gif]].
